scripts.dev: pnpm run ui:build && wrangler dev --ip localhost --port 8787
scripts.build: pnpm run ui:build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm exec wrangler deploy tests/cloud-harness.ts --dry-run --outdir .test-dist && pnpm exec wrangler deploy tests/meeting-done-harness.ts --dry-run --outdir .test-dist/done && tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.check: pnpm types && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @telemetry/collector check
scripts.ui:build: pnpm exec tailwindcss -i src/ui/meeting.css -o dist/meeting.css --minify && tsx scripts/build-meeting-ui.ts
